name: django-allauth-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is django-allauth, a set of Django applications for authentication,
registration and account management: logging in and out, signing up, changing, setting and
resetting passwords, managing and verifying email addresses, logging in by code,
reauthentication and rate limiting, plus third-party (social) account authentication.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the regular-account subsystem of django-allauth: the allauth/account/ package (every Python module under allauth/account/ except its migrations/ package), the allauth/core/ package and the modules allauth/app_settings.py, allauth/utils.py, allauth/decorators.py, allauth/ratelimit.py and allauth/exceptions.py, together with every documentation page under docs/account/, the pages docs/common/index.rst, docs/common/configuration.rst, docs/common/email.rst, docs/common/messages.rst, docs/common/admin.rst and docs/common/rate_limits.rst, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the docume
